description: A priori declared hypotheses for Run B synthetic planted-signal benchmark

feature_selection.fdr_control: tsfresh_selector (Benjamini-Hochberg FDR) and SubsampledFeatureSelector will maintain empirical FDP <= 0.05.
feature_selection.anova_inflation: Standard ANOVA uncorrected p-value thresholding will exhibit severe FDP inflation (> 0.20) under noise columns.
feature_selection.boruta_shadow: Boruta shadow feature comparison will achieve high power (> 0.85) while controlling FDP <= 0.05.

extractor_scaling.explanation: Polars and Numba execute vectorized/compiled kernels without DataFrame copying; tsfresh incurs high per-feature extraction overhead.
